caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright ceramic bottle positioned centrally against a plain, light-colored background. The bottle has a cylindrical body that widens slightly toward the base and tapers toward the neck, which is short and capped with a wider, rounded rim. The surface of the bottle is colored in various shades of brown, with some variations and lighter highlights giving the impression of light reflection and texture typical of glazed ceramics. There are subtle shadows and color gradations on the bottle that indicate its three-dimensional form. The background is an even, pale beige or off-white color with minimal detail, ensuring the focus remains solely on the bottle. There are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Beer Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
